newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH SHIPPING FIRM PLO READIES FOR PRIVATISATION.
newsitem.headline: POLISH SHIPPING FIRM PLO READIES FOR PRIVATISATION.

text.p: Polish shipping firm Polish Ocean Lines Group (Grupa PLO) will be privatised in a few years' time, its director said on Monday.
"Currently, a foreign consulting company is preparing an analysis which will help us choose the best way of selling PLO," Jerzy Barski told Reuters.
Barski did not specify when the process would start, but said it would last "several years".
The company intends to spend $200 million on its investment and development in the next three years, raising the cash from credit and own funds, Barski said.
He said Grupa PLO reported a net profit of around one million zlotys in 1996 after seven years of losses. In the first half of 1997 the compny had sales of 500 million.
It shipped cargo totalling 1.6 million tonnes and 61,859 TEU of containers, marking a five percent growth against the same period last year.
